summary: Close F-012 by defining the 1 metre scene surround once as SCENE_SURROUND_M and making stand setup and renderer consume that canonical value without changing scene geometry.

impactAnalysis.notes: F-012 is an ownership-only remediation. The physical surround remains exactly 1 metre. standSetup and scene3d now consume SCENE_SURROUND_M from one canonical source. scene3d's behavior/state/placement/performance domains are declared affected because the source-file governance map requires those domains whenever scene3d changes; no module behavior, editable-state schema, placement algorithm, performance policy, catalog, persistence, BOM, or asset semantics are intentionally changed. The existing browser smoke flow creates a real stage and therefore protects runtime module loading after the shared import change.

e2e.reason: The renderer import path changes, so the real browser stage-creation smoke flow must prove the application loads and creates the stage with no runtime error.

risk.notes: The value remains 1 metre and all arithmetic is unchanged; the change removes duplicate ownership and renames consumers to the canonical constant.

migration.notes: No persisted project-state or archive schema changes.

rollback: Revert the F-012 single-source commits if stage setup dimensions, grid extents, camera framing, or stage creation regress.
